youtube.description:
Sing Baa Baa Black Sheep with Robo and learn colours! A black sheep says baa and gives three bags of wool, then more sheep are hiding on the farm: look at the wool peeking over the hay, say which colour it is, count down 3, 2, 1 and see them jump out. Sing a verse for every colour, count the three bags, say the colour on your turn and fill up the wool tracker. A surprise colour waits in the barn, then a quick point-to-it quiz with balls of yarn.

Colours: black, white, red, blue and yellow, and counting to three ("three bags full").

Sing at home: point to something red, blue or yellow in your room after each verse, count three things together, and ask "What colour is it?". Baa Baa Black Sheep is a traditional public-domain rhyme sung to its traditional tune; the white, red, blue and yellow verses are original lyrics written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.

do.text: Wool! A bag of black wool!
Let's fill our bags with colours of wool!
And one colour is a surprise in the barn!
Baa, baa, black sheep, have you any wool?
Yes sir, yes sir, three bags full!
do.tune: F4 F4 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2

do.text: One for the master, and one for the dame,
And one for the little boy who lives down the lane.
Baa, baa, black sheep, have you any wool?
Yes sir, yes sir, three bags full!
do.tune: F4 F4 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2

do.text: Three bags of black wool! Thank you, black sheep!
Which colour is next? Look at the hay!
Look at the wool! What colour is it?
Baa, baa, white sheep, have you any wool?
Yes, yes, white wool, three bags full!
do.tune: F4 F4 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2

do.text: One for a snowman, and one for a kite,
And one for a bunny all fluffy and white.
Hooray! White! Like a fluffy cloud!
Who is hiding now? Which colour?
Look at the wool! What colour is it?
Baa, baa, red sheep, have you any wool?
Yes, yes, red wool, three bags full!
do.tune: F4 F4 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2

do.text: One for a red hat, and one for a bow,
And one for a scarf that is red like a rose.
Another sheep! Which colour is next?
Look at the wool! What colour is it?
Baa, baa, blue sheep, have you any wool?
Yes, yes, blue wool, three bags full!
do.tune: F4 F4 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2

do.text: One for the blue sky, and one for the sea,
And one for a blanket as blue as can be.
Now the surprise colour! Who is in the barn?
Which colour is it? Let's open the doors!
Baa, baa, yellow sheep, have you any wool?
Yes, yes, yellow wool, three bags full!
One for the sunshine, and one for a bee,
And one for a chick that's as yellow as me!
All the wool is yarn now! Let's play!
Which sheep is yellow? Point to it!
Baa, baa, black sheep, have you any wool?
Yes sir, yes sir, three bags full!
do.tune: F4 F4 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2

do.text: Black, white, red, blue, and yellow!
